title: RFP & Proposal Operations
summary: Check an approved requirement matrix for owners, answer evidence, review status and submission deadlines; prepare a proposal completion worklist.

inputs.label: RFP requirement and response matrix
inputs.description: One row per requirement, normalized by the proposal owner from the solicitation and approved answer library. Answer text and evidence references are supplied, not invented.

connections.name: Solicitation and approved answer library
prerequisites: Read-scoped workspace export with requirement IDs and document versions
Answer-library owner has marked approved responses and their source references
Proposal manager confirms submission date and time zone

sample_goal: Find unowned, unsupported and unreviewed answers plus an approaching submission in the synthetic RFP matrix.
deliverable: Requirement compliance matrix and response-completion worklist
acceptance: Preserve every supplied requirement and its source in the evidence register.
Identify missing ownership and answer citations without manufacturing responses.
Flag nonapproved responses and due submissions for the proposal manager.
Submission completeness is conditional on the owner-supplied matrix being complete.
stop_conditions: Stop at an ambiguous requirement, missing solicitation version or unsupported pricing claim.
Escalate confidential answer disclosure and any commitment outside approved material.
blocked_actions: Commit pricing, dates, warranties or scope

rules.title: Requirement has an answer owner
rules.action: Assign a qualified owner to the requirement.

rules.title: Answer has an evidence reference
rules.action: Obtain a source-backed answer from the approved library.

rules.title: Response has completed review
rules.action: Route the supplied response for proposal-owner review.

rules.title: Submission needs attention within two days
rules.action: Prepare the remaining submission checklist for the proposal manager.

records.answer_text: Phased setup per approved implementation guide.
Use the attached approved pricing schedule.

title: Customer Onboarding
summary: Review setup, document, training and handoff milestones against supplied completion evidence and prepare an activation-readiness checklist.

inputs.label: Customer onboarding milestones
inputs.description: Approved export for one customer implementation. Each milestone carries an accountable owner, completion status, evidence reference and agreed due date.

connections.name: Customer implementation tracker
prerequisites: Workspace-scoped customer export and customer identifier
Owner-approved activation criteria and milestone list
Read authorization for the referenced setup and training evidence

sample_goal: Identify missing evidence, an unowned handoff and unfinished milestones in a synthetic implementation.
deliverable: Onboarding readiness checklist and handoff exceptions
acceptance: Keep setup, documents, training and handoff milestones separately traceable.
Treat completion status without evidence as a review exception.
Show unfinished milestones and overdue unfinished work.
Do not label an account activated or change customer systems.
stop_conditions: Stop when customer identity or project scope is ambiguous.
Escalate missing activation criteria, unresolved security requirements or a requested access change.
blocked_actions: Mark a customer activated in a live service
Promise delivery dates or policy exceptions

rules.title: Milestone has an accountable owner
rules.action: Assign the milestone to the onboarding lead or responsible function.

rules.title: Milestone has completion evidence
rules.action: Collect and review the milestone evidence before claiming completion.

rules.title: Activation milestone is complete
rules.action: Prepare the remaining task and handoff for the onboarding lead.

rules.title: Unfinished milestone is overdue
rules.action: Review the overdue milestone and propose a recovery date.

title: Customer Success & Renewal Preparation
summary: Compare approved account usage and unresolved commitments with owner-set thresholds and prepare evidence-linked renewal review actions.

inputs.label: Account renewal review export
inputs.description: One row per account. Usage counts, minimum engagement thresholds, support commitments and notice dates must be normalized and approved by the account owner.

connections.name: CRM, usage and support exports
prerequisites: Read-scoped exports for the selected accounts only
Contract renewal dates and owner-approved usage thresholds
Support commitment counts reconciled to the cited account-review evidence

sample_goal: Flag a usage shortfall, unresolved commitments and an approaching renewal in synthetic accounts.
deliverable: Customer review brief inputs and renewal preparation worklist
acceptance: Cite the supplied review evidence for each account.
Report threshold comparisons and open commitment gaps without inventing churn predictions.
Identify renewal dates within thirty days.
Keep commercial offers and customer follow-ups as drafts for the account owner.
stop_conditions: Stop if account ownership, consent to usage data or renewal dates are uncertain.
Escalate commitments requiring product, legal or commercial approval.

rules.title: Usage meets the account review threshold
rules.action: Ask the account owner to investigate the documented adoption shortfall.

rules.title: Open commitments fit the agreed review threshold
rules.action: Prepare an owner review of outstanding support or delivery commitments.

rules.title: Renewal is due within thirty days
rules.action: Prepare the renewal meeting brief and current unresolved commitments.

rules.title: Account review has supporting evidence
rules.action: Obtain the source-linked account review before presenting conclusions.

title: Insurance Certificate Desk
summary: Compare normalized certificate limits and expiry dates with supplied contractual requirements; prepare coverage-document gaps for qualified review.

inputs.label: Certificate requirement comparison
inputs.description: One row per supplier coverage requirement, with limits normalized to the same currency and basis by a qualified reviewer. A certificate is not proof that every policy condition is satisfied.

connections.name: Vendor insurance and contract repository
prerequisites: Approved read-scoped certificate and contract export
Qualified owner confirms comparable coverage types, currencies and limit bases
Relevant endorsement references and certificate expiration dates

sample_goal: Find an insufficient limit, an approaching expiry and a missing endorsement in synthetic vendor certificates.
deliverable: Certificate expiry register and contractual gap review packet
acceptance: Show the supplied requirement, certified limit and document source for each comparison.
Flag limits below requirements and expirations within thirty days.
Treat missing endorsement evidence as a gap, not a coverage conclusion.
Refer interpretation and acceptance to the qualified risk or legal owner.
stop_conditions: Stop when coverage basis, currency or contractual interpretation is unclear.
Escalate suspected falsification or conflicting policy and certificate evidence.
blocked_actions: Bind, renew or cancel a policy
Send a coverage representation to another party

rules.title: Supplied certificate limit meets the stated requirement
rules.action: Ask the qualified reviewer to resolve the documented limit gap.

rules.title: Certificate expires within thirty days
rules.action: Prepare a renewal-evidence request for the vendor owner.

rules.title: Required endorsement has a reference
rules.action: Obtain the required endorsement for qualified review.

title: License & Permit Operations
summary: Check an owner-maintained obligation calendar for renewal deadlines, accountable owners and application evidence; prepare renewal work for authorized people.

inputs.label: License and permit obligation register
inputs.description: An approved register of applicable permits and licenses. The qualified owner determines applicability, jurisdiction and renewal dates; the workflow does not infer law from generic rules.

connections.name: Permit and license register
prerequisites: Read-scoped register with the competent authority and official requirement reference
Accountable owner verifies jurisdiction, applicability and due dates
Approved copies of current permits and renewal attachment lists

sample_goal: Identify a near-term renewal, missing owner and missing application evidence in a synthetic obligation register.
deliverable: Renewal obligation calendar and application-readiness worklist
acceptance: Preserve the authority reference and accountable owner for every obligation.
Flag renewals within sixty days except rows explicitly recorded as renewed.
Identify missing application evidence and official requirement references.
Prepare review tasks without submitting or declaring legal compliance.
stop_conditions: Stop if the applicable authority, date calculation or obligation scope is unresolved.
Escalate expired permission or safety-critical operating restrictions to the responsible qualified owner.
blocked_actions: Submit, sign or pay for a permit application

rules.title: Renewal preparation is due within sixty days
rules.action: Prepare the renewal checklist for the authorized applicant.

rules.title: Obligation has an accountable owner
rules.action: Assign an authorized owner for this obligation.

rules.title: Renewal attachments have a reference
rules.action: Collect the required application attachments for review.

rules.title: Obligation cites its official requirement
rules.action: Ask the qualified owner to verify and cite the authority requirement.

title: Data Quality Operations
summary: Check approved record exports for duplicate business keys, missing contact fields and inconsistent amount relationships; prepare correction proposals for data owners.

inputs.label: Business record quality export
inputs.description: A scoped, minimized data extract with an owner-approved business key and field rules. Export row IDs must remain unique even where business keys are duplicated.

connections.name: Approved data-quality extract
prerequisites: Read-only export for the named dataset and workspace
Owner-approved unique-key definition and nullable-field policy
Documented currency, gross/net definitions and extraction time

sample_goal: Detect both members of a duplicate key pair, a missing contact address and a net amount exceeding gross in synthetic records.
deliverable: Source-linked data defect and proposed correction register
acceptance: Report every member of a duplicate business-key group without merging records.
Separate missing values from numeric relationship exceptions.
Retain source row identifiers so owners can verify an approved correction in a later run.
Do not infer which conflicting record is authoritative.
stop_conditions: Stop if the key definition, amount units or record ownership are ambiguous.
Escalate sensitive fields that exceed the approved data-minimization scope.

rules.title: Business key is unique
rules.action: Ask the data owner to reconcile all records sharing this key.

rules.title: Required contact address is present
rules.action: Request the missing contact value from the authoritative owner.

rules.title: Net amount does not exceed gross
rules.action: Review the amount mapping and propose a documented correction.

title: Procurement Sourcing
summary: Compare owner-normalized supplier quotations with budget, delivery and mandatory requirement criteria; prepare sourcing exceptions for a purchasing decision.

inputs.label: Normalized supplier quotation comparison
inputs.description: One row per quote for the same approved specification and quantity. Delivered totals include owner-approved taxes, freight and currency assumptions; no exchange rate is fetched or invented.

connections.name: Approved supplier quotes and requirement sheet
prerequisites: Read-scoped approved quote copies and specification revision
Purchasing owner verifies quantity, unit, currency and delivered-cost normalization
Named budget authority and maximum delivery lead time

sample_goal: Find a quote exceeding cost and lead-time limits, a currency mismatch and missing mandatory specification evidence.
acceptance: Keep supplier quote references alongside normalized values and requirements.
Flag cost and lead-time exceptions without making an award.
Do not treat a different currency as a comparable amount.
Identify missing mandatory specification evidence before a recommendation is accepted.
stop_conditions: Stop if quote quantity, currency, price basis or specification version cannot be reconciled.
Escalate conflicts of interest or requests to bypass purchasing authority.
blocked_actions: Place orders or issue purchase commitments

rules.title: Delivered quote total fits the approved comparison ceiling
rules.action: Prepare the cost exception for the procurement manager.

rules.title: Delivery lead time meets the stated need
rules.action: Ask the procurement owner to review the delivery gap.

rules.title: Quote uses the comparison currency
rules.action: Obtain an owner-approved currency-normalized comparison before ranking.

rules.title: Mandatory specification has evidence
rules.action: Collect evidence for the mandatory specification before recommending the quote.

title: Expense Review
summary: Review normalized expense claims for policy limits, duplicate receipts and missing documentation; prepare finance exceptions without approving reimbursement.

inputs.label: Expense and policy comparison export
inputs.description: Approved, minimized claim export with a policy owner-supplied limit for each expense category. Amounts and limits must use the same currency and period.

connections.name: Expense claims and policy repository
prerequisites: Read-only scoped expense export and receipt references
Policy version and category-specific limits verified by the policy owner
Approved handling of employee and payment-related information

sample_goal: Find a duplicate receipt pair, missing purpose and receipt evidence, and a claim over its supplied limit.
deliverable: Expense exception worklist for finance review
acceptance: Report both entries using a duplicated receipt identifier.
Cite claim sources, supplied limits and missing supporting material.
Distinguish a possible duplicate or policy exception from fraud.
Leave approval, reimbursement and employee decisions to authorized people.
stop_conditions: Stop when currency, policy applicability or receipt identity is uncertain.
Escalate suspected misconduct confidentially without making a disciplinary determination.
blocked_actions: Approve, reject or reimburse a claim

rules.title: Receipt identifier is used once
rules.action: Review all claims sharing this receipt before deciding whether either is payable.

rules.title: Claim amount fits its supplied policy limit
rules.action: Prepare the amount exception for the expense policy owner.

rules.title: Claim has a business purpose
rules.action: Prepare a request for the missing business-purpose documentation.

rules.title: Claim has receipt evidence
rules.action: Prepare a request for the receipt supporting this claim.

title: IT Service Desk
summary: Check service tickets for routing ownership, approved runbooks, diagnostic evidence and response deadlines; prepare safe next steps for the service owner.

inputs.label: Service ticket triage export
inputs.description: Read-only export of scoped tickets and their selected runbook metadata. Diagnostics are references to previously approved collection, not permission to run commands.

connections.name: Service desk and approved runbook library
prerequisites: Read-scoped ticket export and asset identifiers
Runbook versions approved for the selected ticket categories
Diagnostic references and response targets supplied by the service owner

sample_goal: Find an unassigned overdue ticket, an unapproved runbook and a missing diagnostic reference.
acceptance: Preserve ticket and diagnostic references for the service owner.
Flag absent routing owners and unapproved runbook selections.
Identify missing diagnostics and elapsed response deadlines.
Provide review actions without executing fixes or changing tickets.
stop_conditions: Stop before any proposed command, credential request or access change.
Escalate suspected security incidents and unsupported runbooks to the appropriate owner.
blocked_actions: Change ticket state or send requester messages

rules.title: Ticket has a routing owner
rules.action: Prepare the ticket routing decision for the service desk lead.

rules.title: Selected runbook is approved
rules.action: Escalate the runbook selection to an authorized service owner.

rules.title: Ticket has diagnostic evidence
rules.action: Prepare the minimum diagnostic request for authorized collection.

rules.title: Unresolved ticket response is due
rules.action: Prepare the overdue response exception for the service desk lead.

title: Incident Coordination
summary: Organize owner-supplied incident events, evidence and response commitments into a coordination record with gaps requiring human follow-through.

inputs.label: Incident timeline and action register
inputs.description: One normalized row per incident event or action. Timestamps, evidence pointers and update commitments come from the authorized response team; chronology and facts require their review.

connections.name: Incident timeline and evidence repository
prerequisites: Incident-scoped read authorization and designated commander
Approved evidence references with collection times and custody metadata
Response team supplies action owners and next update commitments

sample_goal: Find an unowned action, a missing timestamp and evidence reference, and an overdue incident update.
deliverable: Incident coordination timeline, evidence index and review actions
acceptance: Preserve supplied event descriptions and source pointers without embellishing facts.
Flag missing action ownership, timestamps and evidence.
Identify overdue updates for open incident work.
Prepare post-incident review inputs without taking response or containment actions.
stop_conditions: Stop when incident scope, commander authority or evidence custody is unclear.
Escalate immediate safety or security decisions to the qualified response lead.
blocked_actions: Send public, regulatory or customer incident notifications

rules.title: Incident action has an owner
rules.action: Ask the incident commander to assign the open action.

rules.title: Event has a recorded timestamp
rules.action: Ask the response team to verify and record the event time.

rules.title: Event has an evidence reference
rules.action: Preserve and reference supporting evidence through the authorized process.

rules.title: Open incident update is overdue
rules.action: Prepare the overdue status-update request for the incident commander.

title: Research & Competitive Intelligence
summary: Review selected public-source observations against supplied baselines and freshness dates; prepare evidence-linked change investigations.

inputs.label: Dated public-source observations
inputs.description: Approved observations from selected public sources, including comparable numeric current and baseline values. Collection is performed separately; this workflow does not browse or claim to verify source content.

connections.name: Approved public-source observation export
prerequisites: Research owner selects permitted public sources and collection purpose
Each observation includes a URL, collection date, baseline and common measurement unit
Owner-approved freshness deadlines and lawful content retention

sample_goal: Flag a changed reported metric, a missing public URL, a nonpublic source marker and an expired freshness review.
deliverable: Public-source change brief inputs and verification worklist
acceptance: Cite supplied URLs and collection metadata rather than inventing sources.
Identify numeric differences from the supplied baseline with unchanged observations retained.
Flag nonpublic sources and stale observations for exclusion or review.
Treat changes as investigation candidates; do not infer strategy or causation without review.
stop_conditions: Stop before using restricted, private or unlawfully obtained material.
Escalate inconsistent units, unsupported claims or missing baseline provenance.
blocked_actions: Access private accounts or bypass access restrictions
Scrape or fetch sources in this workflow

rules.title: Observation cites a public source URL
rules.action: Obtain the exact permitted public source reference before using the observation.

rules.title: Reported metric matches its supplied baseline
rules.action: Investigate and cite the documented change before interpreting its significance.

rules.title: Source is marked public
rules.action: Exclude the restricted observation and ask the research owner for a permitted public source.

rules.title: Observation needs a freshness review
rules.action: Refresh or reverify the observation through the authorized research process.

title: Board & Committee Operations
summary: Check agenda items, packet references, review status and decision follow-up dates; prepare a confidential board or committee readiness worklist.

inputs.label: Agenda, packet and action register
inputs.description: Approved register for one board or committee. Supporting materials and distribution authorization remain controlled by the corporate secretary.

connections.name: Restricted board materials repository
prerequisites: Read authorization for the specific board or committee and meeting
Corporate secretary confirms agenda, packet version and permitted audience
Owner-provided decisions, action assignments and follow-up dates

sample_goal: Find an unowned agenda action, missing unapproved packet material and an overdue decision follow-up.
deliverable: Meeting packet readiness index and decision-action register
acceptance: Retain the meeting, agenda item, owner and evidence reference for each entry.
Flag missing materials and nonapproved packet items before distribution.
Track overdue open follow-ups without sending messages.
Preserve confidentiality and leave minutes, resolutions and decisions to authorized reviewers.
stop_conditions: Stop if board membership, distribution authority or privileged scope is uncertain.
Escalate contradictory decisions or unsigned resolutions to the corporate secretary or counsel.
blocked_actions: Distribute board packets or send follow-ups
Make governance decisions or sign filings

rules.title: Agenda item or action has an owner
rules.action: Ask the corporate secretary to confirm the responsible owner.

rules.title: Packet item has supporting material
rules.action: Collect the approved packet material within the restricted workspace.

rules.title: Packet item has completed review
rules.action: Route the packet item for the authorized reviewer before distribution.

rules.title: Open decision follow-up is due
rules.action: Prepare the follow-up for the secretary to review and send if authorized.
